_comment: Spider config template. Copy this file as settings.json and fill in actual values. settings.json should NOT be committed to version control.
_browser_comment: Browser type: chrome | chromium | firefox | edge. Default: chrome
_headless_comment: Headless mode. true=run in background, false=visible window
_keepOpen_comment: Keep browser window open after scraping
_cdpPort_comment: CDP debug port. Used to connect to an existing browser instance

sites._comment: Per-domain site authentication config. Supports ${ENV_VAR} environment variable references
